coucheF.q1: Has she been away from home more than before lately?
coucheF.q1a: No, the schedule hasn't shifted at all.
coucheF.q1b: A bit more, but she always tells me where she's going and with whom.
coucheF.q1c: Yes, and the explanations stay vague when I ask.
coucheF.q1d: Yes, and she gets annoyed the moment I ask where she was.
coucheF.q2: How does she behave with her phone when you're next to her?
coucheF.q2a: It lies around, I can pick it up and nobody minds.
coucheF.q2b: It stays on her, but that has always been the case.
coucheF.q2c: She turns it face down on the table, and she changed the passcode recently.
coucheF.q2d: She gets aggressive if I come near, or she stays glued to me while I look.
coucheF.q3: And your sex life, over the last few weeks?
coucheF.q3a: The same as usual, no more and no less.
coucheF.q3b: A little less often, but we're going through a busy stretch.
coucheF.q3c: It stopped almost overnight, with no explanation.
coucheF.q3d: It changed in nature: new habits that came out of nowhere.
coucheF.q4: Has she changed her appearance in the last few months?
coucheF.q4b: She got back into sport, we'd talked about it together.
coucheF.q4c: New perfume, new clothes, new haircut: all of it at once.
coucheF.q4d: She mostly gets ready on the days she goes out without me.
coucheF.q5: Does one name keep coming up in what she tells you?
coucheF.q5a: No, she talks about the same people as before.
coucheF.q5b: Yes, a new colleague or a new friend, mentioned naturally.
coucheF.q5c: One name came up constantly, then she stopped mentioning it overnight.
coucheF.q5d: She plays that person down the moment I ask anything about them.
coucheF.q6: What's going on with the social media side?
coucheF.q6a: Nothing new, I see pretty much everything.
coucheF.q6b: She spends more time on it than before, but hides nothing.
coucheF.q6c: Notifications are muted, or I saw a conversation archived.
coucheF.q6d: I saw a message go by that she deleted right afterwards.
coucheF.q7: Does she call you jealous or paranoid when you ask a question?
coucheF.q7b: She sighs a bit, but ends up answering.
coucheF.q7c: Yes, and the conversation always ends up turned against me.
coucheF.q7d: Yes, and she accuses me of cheating when I'm not.
coucheF.q8: Have you noticed spending you can't account for?
coucheF.q8a: No, the accounts are clear between us.
coucheF.q8b: A few cash withdrawals, nothing unusual for her.
coucheF.q8c: Restaurants, hotels or gifts I've never heard a word about.
coucheF.q8d: She opened an account or a card she never mentioned.
coucheF.q9: Do the explanations hold up when you cross-check them?
coucheF.q9b: She gets a detail wrong now and then, like anyone.
coucheF.q9c: One or two versions didn't match, and she corrected them afterwards.
coucheF.q9d: I have proof she lied to me about where she was.
coucheF.q10: How do the people close to her behave around you?
coucheF.q10a: The same as before, no awkwardness.
coucheF.q10b: I see them less, but our schedules changed.
coucheF.q10c: There's a pause when I walk in, or subjects we avoid in front of me.
coucheF.q10d: Someone warned me, or said something half-spoken.
coucheF.q11: Has she become attentive in a way that isn't like her?
coucheF.q11a: She's the way she has always been.
coucheF.q11b: She's making an effort, and we'd talked about it beforehand.
coucheF.q11c: She buys me things for no reason, which isn't her style.
coucheF.q11d: She swings with no warning: very present, then cold and distant.
coucheF.q12: What happens when you offer to come along somewhere?
coucheF.q12a: It makes them happy, it has never been an issue.
coucheF.q12b: Sometimes she'd rather go alone, and she says so plainly.
coucheF.q12c: She always finds a good reason for me not to come.
coucheF.q12d: She has already cancelled an outing because I wanted to come.
coucheF.q13: Do they ever come home very late, or not at all?
coucheF.q13b: Yes, but it's planned in advance and I know who she's with.
coucheF.q13c: More and more often, and I find out at the last minute.
coucheF.q13d: Yes, and she showers or changes clothes before even talking to me.
coucheF.q14: Have you seen underwear appear that you'd never seen on her before?
coucheF.q14a: No, nothing new among her things.
coucheF.q14b: She bought some more, we'd talked about it or I went with her.
coucheF.q14c: Yes, brand new pieces I've never seen at home.
coucheF.q14d: Yes, and she wears them on the days she goes out without me.
coucheF.q15: And your gut feeling, honestly, what does it say?
coucheF.q15a: Nothing much, I'm taking this test out of curiosity.
coucheF.q15b: I have a doubt, but mostly I think I'm imagining things.
coucheF.q15c: Something has changed, I've felt it for weeks.
coucheF.q15d: I'm almost certain, I'm just missing the proof.
